items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: I knew it was Count Basie with Bennie Moten’s band... I said, 'Well that’s Count Basie playing a little combination Fats Waller and four hands in his early records with Benny Moten’s Kansas City Orchestra'

ctx.x: Right. Well you got into the radio through Columbia University.

Absolutely. And through my sound career. But when I got to Columbia most of the people in Furnald, the dormitory I lived in, they didn’t really know what I was playing but they knew it wasn’t what they were used to listening to and they vaguely understood it was jazz and everybody kept saying that I should go see Jamie Katz, who lived, well I was on 1006 Fernald and he lived in, like it was interconnected, I think it was 732, 33, 34. They reconfigured the doors but not the rooms in that building so it’s all moved…
